IN PHOTOS │Thousands of commuters head home for the holidays as traffic along EDSA-Cubao tightens, turning the busy thoroughfare into a sea of brake lights. While the MRT-3 continues to ferry passengers efficiently overhead, bus terminals and private lanes struggle under the seasonal exodus, prompting authorities to deploy additional traffic personnel.

📸: Edd Castro
